svg.title: Pipeline overview
svg.desc: Seven-stage pipeline: 308 markdown articles are preprocessed, species are grounded to NCBITaxon in code, Qwen extracts one compact line per claim, code parses, guards and merges, grounds the remaining terms in eight ontology indexes, then writes and validates one merged CAMO v0.10.0 graph in YAML and JSON.
svg.text: 308 articles in, one merged CAMO graph out
One command, seven stages. Only stage 3 calls the model.
schema v0.10.0, YAML + JSON, one source document with its DOI per article; every edge carries its sentence and character offsets
Design principle: the model only reads the text; everything that can be checked mechanically is done in code.
* Team's own scorer, standard edge matching vs. the human Murphy 2005 gold; measured before stage 5b was switched on. Not the judges' score.
